_comment: Acceptance-surface roster for the split-artifact release gate (#2649). #2649's acceptance names five surfaces: composition, exported files, bootstrap, stdio initialization, and --no-dev exclusion. stdio initialization is #2659, which is gated behind #2657's design, which is not accepted, so it is recorded as reserved with its blocking issue rather than narrowing the acceptance in silence. The development metapackage (waaseyaa/ai-development) was reserved the same way because #2655 DEPENDED ON #2649 and requiring it here would have made the pair circular; #2655 has landed, the fail-closed hatch fired as designed, and that member is now live. tests/Architecture/SplitArtifactAcceptanceGateTest.php binds this file to the harness so a live surface cannot lose its implementation and a reserved surface cannot lose its blocking issue.

surfaces.note: The installed waaseyaa/* set equals the sealed transitive closure of waaseyaa/framework exactly, every member carries the sealed candidate version, and every member was installed from a zip dist inside the local artifact repository.

Every installed package tree is byte-identical to the archive git exported, the skeleton's pinned exported paths survive create-project, and the #2543 admin-surface manifests are consumed as a pinned fixture through the documented consumer procedure.
The artifact-installed consumer completes the governed installation phase and then boots through ordinary runtime, with a day-one entity round-trip. Both the dev and the --no-dev consumer are booted.

Reserved. stdio initialization is #2659, which is gated behind #2657's design and is not accepted. When it lands, add an assert_stdio_initialization() hook to tests/PackagedForm/split-artifact-acceptance.php, drive it from the artifact-installed consumer in tests/PackagedForm/check-split-artifact-acceptance, and flip this entry to live.
A second consumer installed with --no-dev carries no development dependency, registers no test namespace, retains the complete runtime closure, and still boots.

artifact_repository_members.note: Sealed from HEAD:skeleton and consumed through composer create-project.
Sealed from HEAD. This is the whole-repository dist Packagist serves for the metapackage manifest, not a trimmed stand-in.
Every packages/*/composer.json is sealed from HEAD:packages/<dir>, which is the tree the split mirror publishes.

Live since #2655. The reserved entry's fail-closed hatch fired as designed the moment packages/ai-development existed, and assert_development_plane() now asserts the claim instead of deferring it: the plane is sealed as a split artifact, arrives in the dev consumer as a development dependency, carries the two members ADR-022 D-2 makes mandatory (waaseyaa/ai-agent, waaseyaa/testing), never reaches waaseyaa/mcp (D-1.4), and is absent from the production require closure of waaseyaa/framework (D-1.2). assert_no_dev_exclusion() owns the other half: composer install --no-dev removes every development-only member. Three seeded negative controls prove all of that can fail.
